subject.title: [Bug]: Google vertex is now called Google Enterprise AI

question: What exact user-facing label should OpenClaw use for the `google-vertex` provider while preserving the stable provider/config id?
rationale: Source inspection confirms the visible label is still `Google Vertex AI`, but the issue’s requested wording differs from Google’s current public wording and provider-id renames are compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Use Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Vertex AI)
options.body: Update visible labels/docs to bridge Google’s current name with the existing Vertex API/provider identity, without renaming `google-vertex`.

options.title: Keep Google Vertex AI for now
options.body: Leave current copy until Google’s API, SDK, and OpenClaw provider docs fully settle on the new public name.

options.title: Use Google Enterprise AI
options.body: Follow the reporter’s original wording, accepting that it did not match the official page title checked during review.

recommendation.title: Use Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform (Vertex AI)
recommendation.body: Update visible labels/docs to bridge Google’s current name with the existing Vertex API/provider identity, without renaming `google-vertex`.
